answers.reason: The full professor belongs to a faculty and only participates in one body, whereas the senate handles central university strategy.
Budget allocation is a central administrative matter handled by the chancellor and university leadership, not the full professor.
Because every member takes part in only one place where their matters are decided, the full professor sits in the faculty council rather than a single-purpose committee.
The full professor holds a chair in the faculty, making the faculty council the one place where their faculty affairs are decided.
Members only sit in one body, and the full professor's general faculty role places them in the faculty council rather than the specialized study commission.
Examination matters are separate from the general faculty affairs where the full professor takes part.
Small internal grants are for building up or assisting in research projects, whereas the full professor takes part in the faculty council.
Rewriting module descriptions is a specialized working group task outside the single body where the full professor participates.
Laboratory equipment procurement is treated as strictly separate from other matters, and the full professor only sits in the faculty council.
Planning the orientation week for new students does not concern the full professor's matters.
